descriptionHtml:
HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Core Gaming Headset dtsX edition (DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio Support / PC Compatible / 40mm Dynamic Drivers / Bi-Directional Noise-Canceling Mic / Onboard Audio Controls / Included PC Splitter Cable / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Elevate your PC gaming audio experience with immersive spatial sound using the HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Core Gaming Headset dtsX edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Tailored specifically for PC gamers, this lightweight 0.60lb (275g) headset utilizes 40mm dynamic directional neodymium drivers delivering accurate 10 Hz - 25 kHz frequency response with low total harmonic distortion under 2 percent. Outfitted with soft foam and breathable fabric earpads, an electret condenser bi-directional noise-canceling mic, onboard volume wheel controls, and a dedicated 3.5mm PC extension splitter cable, it offers exceptional clarity and comfort for prolonged gaming sessions.
